name: Mux Manascrambler
summary: Mux Manascrambler is an eccentric goblin engineer dwelling in the desert outpost of Gadgetzan. Unlike many of his peers focused strictly on explosives or mining equipment, Mux harbors a peculiar fascination with the supernatural and occult energies.

sections.title: A Tinkerer of the Unseen
sections.body: Tucked away inside a building in central Gadgetzan, behind Driz Plunkbow and his clanking Butcherbots, sits Mux Manascrambler. While the Steamwheedle Cartel trades heavily in oil, guns, and salvage, Mux focuses his ingenuity on more esoteric pursuits: the realm of spirits and supernatural anomalies. He uses his technical acumen to design bizarre devices capable of detecting, distilling, and interacting with spectral remnants, bridging crude goblin craftsmanship with the invisible worlds of the dead.

faq.q: Where can I find Mux Manascrambler?
faq.answer: Mux makes his home in Gadgetzan in northern Tanaris. You can find him tucked inside a building near the center of the desert trading hub, positioned just behind Driz Plunkbow and the meat-carving Butcherbots.

faq.q: What kind of work does Mux do?
faq.answer: Mux is an engineer obsessed with spectral and unseen forces. Rather than standard demolitions or transport, he builds specialized contraptions capable of revealing spirits, distilling ectoplasm, and harnessing arcane supernatural power.

faq.q: Does Mux belong to a faction?
faq.answer: Mux belongs to the Steamwheedle Cartel operating out of Gadgetzan. As an independent goblin operative, he maintains strict commercial neutrality and is willing to aid adventurers of either the Horde or the Alliance.

angles.text: Mux is an oddity among goblin tinkers, applying mechanical gears and power cells to capture and distill invisible supernatural forces rather than merely blowing things apart.
